verdict.rationale: Xero documents bill capture (AI extraction from uploaded/emailed bills into draft bills) and batch payment scheduling via exported payment files uploaded to online banking, covering capture and payment ends of the workflow. However, evidence does not show an explicit approval-routing/workflow step (multi-user approval chains) connecting capture to payment in one seamless flow. missing for 10: documented approval routing/workflow between draft bill creation and payment scheduling, independent hands-on confirmation of the end-to-end flow.
